statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R42
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval for this diagnostic procedure
